rows.en: (Yes~! We won!!)
rows.notes: Team events (tug-of-war, ball toss): "we". x6 across both genders.

rows.en:
We did it, \p-san!
Now I can prove to Nanase-san
that I'm not a weakling!

Only natural.
When we join forces, there's nothing
we can't do!
Wowww, that was amazing...
I'm... so moved, I'm about to cry...

(More than anything, I'm happy
we won by all pulling together...)

We lost by a hair...
Now I've ended up looking uncool
in front of Nanase-san instead...

What were we missing?!
Dammit! Dammiiiiiit!!

Everyone, please don't be so down.
You lost this time, but next time
you'll win for sure!
rows.notes: Akimizu is a spectator: "you" for the team.

rows.en:
(I really thought we'd win...
I'll train hard so I definitely
don't lose at the next Sports Day!)

Got it, the ball toss.
I'll take care of the entry,
so go warm up or something.

Oh, \p,
you're in the ball toss too?
With me here, every single throw's going in.

R-right!
The ball toss is something even I can enter,
so I-I'll do my best!
rows.notes: Pinon (small; ball toss is one event she can join).

rows.en:
Good luck, everyone.
We'll be cheering you on with all we've got!

I'm worried someone might get hurt...
Please be careful not to get injured, okay?

Only natural.
This is what happens when you and I get serious.

We did it! We did it!
I was a little bit of help too, you know!
Did you see? Of course you saw, right?

Just what I'd expect from you all.
You made cheering so worth it, we got all
fired up!

That was really amazing, everyone.
Maybe it's thanks to \p-kun being there?

Can't believe we actually lost...
It might rain missiles tomorrow.
rows.notes: Idiom ashita wa yari ga furu adapted by the source to missiles; kept.

rows.en:
No way... after all that effort...
We didn't really lose... did we?
Uuu......

So close...
It came down to such a tiny gap,
that makes it all the more disappointing.

You lost this time,
but next time you'll win for sure!

(I'll train hard so I definitely
don't lose at the next Sports Day!)

(Phew~ Sports Day's finally over.
I'm beat, but it was exciting and really fun.)

(I hope next year's Sports Day is
even more fun than this year's.)

(All right, today's Sports Day!
I'm gonna do my best to shine too!!)
(I'm gonna do my best to take first place!)

Yo, Fresh Girl.
I'm going all out too, so brace yourself.
rows.notes: Furesshu gaaru: "Fresh Girl", female twin of "Fresh Boy" (c22399).

rows.en:
(I can't lose to Saotome-kun or Luis-san.
I'm winning this, just watch!)
(Yes~! First place!!)

So you made it over the wall that is me...
Not bad, Fresh Girl.

(I actually beat Saotome-kun and Luis-san.
I'm so happy.)

(I'd better keep up my training so I can
win at next year's Sports Day too.)
(No way, I was so close to winning...)
(All right! I'd better do my best too!)
(All right! I'm winning this, just watch!)
(Yes~! We won!!)

(More than anything, I'm happy
we won by all pulling together...)

(I really thought we'd win...
I'll train hard so I definitely
don't lose at the next Sports Day!)

That was really amazing, everyone.
Maybe it's thanks to \p-san being there?

(Phew~ Sports Day's finally over.
I'm beat, but it was exciting and really fun.)

(I hope next year's Sports Day is
even more fun than this year's.)

(All right! I'm gonna enjoy this year's
Christmas party even more than last year's!)
(Guess I'll head straight to the party venue.)

(All right! I'm gonna enjoy this year's
Christmas party even more than last year's!)
(Guess I'll head straight to the party venue.)

(I've gotta enjoy today's Christmas party
even more than last year's.)
rows.notes: x7: shared by several male-player Christmas partner scenes.

rows.en: (I'm supposed to meet Yuuto at the school gate...)
rows.notes: Male player calls him Yuuto (given name) here; the female version uses Kagura-kun.

rows.en:
Hey, \p.
Merry Christmas.
Merry Christmas, Yuuto.

I've been looking forward to this year's
Christmas party too. Let's all make it
even livelier than last year!
I wouldn't mind spending it with just you, though...
rows.notes: Kagura, to the player; shared by the male- and female-player scenes, so no gendered wording.

rows.en: N-never mind. Come on, let's go!
Man~ that was fun again this year~
rows.notes: x13, used after many partner scenes of both genders.

rows.en:
But I never expected Yamashiro-sensei
to show up dressed as Santa.
It really was a great Christmas.

I think so too.
Next year, all of us together like this again...
Or maybe next year, a party for just the two of us?
rows.notes: Kagura teasing the player; shared by both genders.

rows.en:
...Just kidding.
Well, see you next year! Have a happy New Year!
rows.notes: Yoi otoshi wo: year-end greeting, "Have a happy New Year!".

rows.en: Yeah, see you next year...

(I'm glad I got to have a fun Christmas...
but Yuuto's last remark kind of surprised me.)

(I've gotta enjoy today's Christmas party
even more than last year's.)

(I'm supposed to meet Kagura-kun
at the school gate...)

Yo, \p.
Merry Christmas.
Merry Christmas, Kagura-kun.

I've been looking forward to this year's
Christmas party too. Let's all make it
even livelier than last year!
Wow~ that was fun again this year.
Yeah, see you next year...

(I'm glad I got to have a fun Christmas...
but Kagura-kun's last remark kind of surprised me.)

(It's Christmas again already this year.
Time sure flies...)

(I ended up going to the Academy's Christmas
party with Gary-sensei, but...)

Yo, \p!
Merry Christmas!

Ah, Gary-sensei!
Merry Christmas!

Still, asking me along shows you've got promise.
Since you're spending it with me,
I'll make it the best Christmas ever!
Huh!? Th-thank you very much!
All right, let's go storm that party!

Yo, \p!
So, how was the Christmas party?

Sensei, that was cruel,
ditching me the moment we walked in...

Hm!?
...Ah, sorry, sorry.
...I just kinda... you know...
rows.notes: Gary trails off (got distracted at the party); kept unfinished.

uncertain: c22455/c22458: Luis's furesshu gaaru kept as 'Fresh Girl' to pair with 'Fresh Boy' (slice 310); no glossary entry.
c22426/c22464: kattazo (no subject) read as 'We won!!' since the lines close the team events (tug-of-war, ball toss); the 100m dash uses its own 'First place!!' lines.
missing_glossary: Fresh Girl / Fresh Boy (Luis's nickname for the player)
